newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Austvin expects to know soon on bid.
newsitem.headline: Austvin expects to know soon on bid.

text.p: Wine producer Australian Vintage Ltd (Austvin) said on Tuesday it expected to know later on Tuesday or on Wednesday whether or not it faced a takeover bid.
"There is possibly (a bid is) out there, I am not sure," Austvin managing director Ivan Limb told Reuters.
"We suspended trading because of the possibility, we expect to understand today or tomorrow whether there is likely to be a bid," he said.
Austvin on Monday requested a suspension of trading of its shares on Tuesday, saying it had received an indication of the possibility of a bid.
Limb said he could not comment whether the request followed a direct approach from a predator, nor on media speculation that Simeon Wines Ltd was a likely bidder.

Foster's Brewing Group Ltd, which last year snapped up the Mildara Blass winemaking group, was also named by industry sources as a potential bidder, amid talk it was also considering a bid for Australia's second largest wine producer, BRL Hardy Ltd.
"Today I have heard that just about everyone in Australia is buying me," Limb said in response to the rumour.
Simeon Wines said earlier it would make a statement on the media speculation on Wednesday following a board meeting on Tuesday.
Austvin shares last traded before their suspension at a 12-month high of A$2.85, valuing the group at A$105.19 million.
